#Behavioral Orientation Analysis
##Load Libraries
```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)
library(circular)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(CircMLE)
library(CircStats)
library(ggplot2)
```

##Import Behavioral Orientation Data
```{r}
frog_data <- read.csv("2024_08_27 Frog Orientation Data.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE)
#View(frog_data)

frog_data %>% 
  group_by(MF) %>% 
  summarise(count=n())
```

##Unimodal Distribution Analysis
```{r}
norm_avg <- frog_data %>% dplyr::select(Norm_Avg_Ang)
frog_circ <- circular(norm_avg, units = "degrees", template = "geographics", modulo = "2pi")
frog_circ_mean <- mean.circular(frog_circ)
frog_circ_mean #mean angle = 85.584
rho.circular(frog_circ) #r = .04385724
rayleigh.test(frog_circ) #p-value = 0.9126
```

##Bimodal Distribution Analysis
```{r}
bi_avg <- frog_data %>% dplyr::select(Bimodal_Norm_Avg_Ang)
bi_frog_circ <- circular(bi_avg, units = "degrees", template = "geographics", modulo = "2pi")
bi_frog_circ_mean <- mean.circular(bi_frog_circ)
bi_frog_circ_mean #mean angle = 305.5
rho.circular(bi_frog_circ) #r = 0.37
rayleigh.test(bi_frog_circ) #p-value= 9e-04
```

###Calculating Bimodal Means and CI's
```{r}
frog_means <- c(152.75, 332.75) #mean angle = 305.5
frog_means_circ <- circular(frog_means, units = "degrees", template = "geographics", modulo = "2pi")
frog_CIs <- c(138.1, 167.4, 318.1, 347.4) #got CI's from Oriana
frog_CIs_circ <- circular(frog_CIs, units = "degrees", template = "geographics", modulo = "2pi")
```

###Plotting Bimodal Normalized Data
```{r}
plot.circular(frog_circ, stack = TRUE, bins = 100, sep = .08, shrink = 1.5, cex = 1.4, axes=FALSE); arrows.circular(frog_means_circ, shrink = 1.6); arrows.circular(frog_CIs_circ, shrink = 1) #edited in illustrator
```

###Plotting 0 deg Treatment
```{r}
N <- frog_data %>% filter(MF==0)
N_circ <- circular(N$Norm_Avg_Ang, units = "degrees", template = "geographics", modulo = "2pi")
N_circ_mean <- mean.circular(N_circ)
plot.circular(N_circ, col= "#CE1256", stack = TRUE, bins = 100, sep = .08, shrink = 1.5, cex = 1.4, axes=FALSE)
```

###Plotting 90 deg Treatment
```{r}
E <- frog_data %>% filter(MF==90)
E_circ <- circular(E$Norm_Avg_Ang, units = "degrees", template = "geographics", modulo = "2pi")
plot.circular(E_circ, col= "#C994C7", stack = TRUE, bins = 100, sep = .08, shrink = 1.5, cex = 1.4, axes=FALSE)
```

###Plotting 180 deg Treatment
```{r}
S <- frog_data %>% filter(MF==180)
S_circ <- circular(S$Norm_Avg_Ang, units = "degrees", template = "geographics", modulo = "2pi")
plot.circular(S_circ, col= "#F768A1", stack = TRUE, bins = 100, sep = .08, shrink = 1.5, cex = 1.4, axes=FALSE)
```

###Plotting 270 deg Treatment
```{r}
W <- frog_data %>% filter(MF==270)
W_circ <- circular(W$Norm_Avg_Ang, units = "degrees", template = "geographics", modulo = "2pi")
plot.circular(W_circ, col= "#7A0177", stack = TRUE, bins = 100, sep = .08, shrink = 1.5, cex = 1.4, axes=FALSE)
```

#Neural Activation Analysis
##Load Libraries
```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)
library(plyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggsignif)
library(outliers)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(broom.mixed)
```

##Import Frog Neural Activation Data
```{r}
neural_act <- read.csv("2025_02_27 Obs Avg w Area.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE)
#View(neural_act)
```

##Checking Correlatation of Analyzers
```{r}
analysis_mod <- lm(Analysis_1 ~ Analysis_2, data = neural_act)
#summary(analysis_mod) #r2 = 0.89; p value = < 2e-16
```

#Arrange Data by Brain Region
```{r}
OB_data <- neural_act %>% filter(Brain_Region == "OB")
MP_data <- neural_act %>% filter(Brain_Region == "MP")
MS_data <-neural_act %>% filter(Brain_Region == "MS")
DP_data <- neural_act %>% filter(Brain_Region == "DP")
LP_data <- neural_act %>% filter(Brain_Region == "LP")
POA_data <- neural_act %>% filter(Brain_Region == "POA")
H_data <- neural_act %>% filter(Brain_Region == "H")
SCN_data <- neural_act%>% filter(Brain_Region == "SCN")
OT_data <- neural_act %>% filter(Brain_Region == "OT")
TS_data <- neural_act %>% filter(Brain_Region == "TS")
CB_data <- neural_act %>% filter(Brain_Region == "CB")
```

##Iglewicz and Hoaglin’s Outlier Filtering
```{r}
OB_data <- OB_data %>%
  mutate(
    modified_z = 0.6745 * (Obs_Avg - median(Obs_Avg)) / mad(Obs_Avg, constant = 1),
    outlier = abs(modified_z) > 3.5
  ) %>%
  filter(!outlier)

MP_data <- MP_data %>%
  mutate(
    modified_z = 0.6745 * (Obs_Avg - median(Obs_Avg)) / mad(Obs_Avg, constant = 1),
    outlier = abs(modified_z) > 3.5
  ) %>%
  filter(!outlier)

MS_data <- MS_data %>%
  mutate(
    modified_z = 0.6745 * (Obs_Avg - median(Obs_Avg)) / mad(Obs_Avg, constant = 1),
    outlier = abs(modified_z) > 3.5
  ) %>%
  filter(!outlier)

DP_data <- DP_data %>%
  mutate(
    modified_z = 0.6745 * (Obs_Avg - median(Obs_Avg)) / mad(Obs_Avg, constant = 1),
    outlier = abs(modified_z) > 3.5
  ) %>%
  filter(!outlier)

LP_data <- LP_data %>%
  mutate(
    modified_z = 0.6745 * (Obs_Avg - median(Obs_Avg)) / mad(Obs_Avg, constant = 1),
    outlier = abs(modified_z) > 3.5
  ) %>%
  filter(!outlier)

POA_data <- POA_data %>%
  mutate(
    modified_z = 0.6745 * (Obs_Avg - median(Obs_Avg)) / mad(Obs_Avg, constant = 1),
    outlier = abs(modified_z) > 3.5
  ) %>%
  filter(!outlier)

H_data <- H_data %>%
  mutate(
    modified_z = 0.6745 * (Obs_Avg - median(Obs_Avg)) / mad(Obs_Avg, constant = 1),
    outlier = abs(modified_z) > 3.5
  ) %>%
  filter(!outlier)

SCN_data <- SCN_data %>%
  mutate(
    modified_z = 0.6745 * (Obs_Avg - median(Obs_Avg)) / mad(Obs_Avg, constant = 1),
    outlier = abs(modified_z) > 3.5
  ) %>%
  filter(!outlier)

OT_data <- OT_data %>%
  mutate(
    modified_z = 0.6745 * (Obs_Avg - median(Obs_Avg)) / mad(Obs_Avg, constant = 1),
    outlier = abs(modified_z) > 3.5
  ) %>%
  filter(!outlier)

TS_data <- TS_data %>%
  mutate(
    modified_z = 0.6745 * (Obs_Avg - median(Obs_Avg)) / mad(Obs_Avg, constant = 1),
    outlier = abs(modified_z) > 3.5
  ) %>%
  filter(!outlier)

CB_data <- CB_data %>%
  mutate(
    modified_z = 0.6745 * (Obs_Avg - median(Obs_Avg)) / mad(Obs_Avg, constant = 1),
    outlier = abs(modified_z) > 3.5
  ) %>%
  filter(!outlier)
```

##Combining Data Post Filtering Outliers
```{r}
neural_act <- rbind(OB_data, MP_data, MS_data, DP_data, LP_data, POA_data, H_data, SCN_data, OT_data, TS_data, CB_data)
```

##Negative Binomal Model Investigation
```{r}
nb_mod_all3 <- glmmTMB(Obs_Avg ~ Treatment*Brain_Region + offset(log(Area)) + (1 | Frog_ID), family=nbinom2(), neural_act)
```

##Checking Negative Binomial Model Fit
```{r}
nb_sim_output3 <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(fittedModel = nb_mod_all3, plot = F)
plot(nb_sim_output3) #QQ plot shows residuals behave as expected (KS, dispersion, and outlier test all NS)
DHARMa::testDispersion(nb_mod_all3) #histogram of residuals is not significant, no evidence for dispersion issues
DHARMa::testZeroInflation(nb_sim_output3) #not significant, no evidence for zero-inflation
```

##Negative Binomial Model Analysis of Deviance Table
```{r}
summary(nb_mod_all3)
glmmTMB:::Anova.glmmTMB(nb_mod_all3, type ="II")
```
##Negative Binomial Post Hoc Statistical Testing
```{r}
all_emmeans3 <- emmeans(nb_mod_all3, pairwise ~ Treatment|Brain_Region, data = neural_act, adjust = "tukey")
summary(all_emmeans3) #LP and H have significant differences between treatments

pairwise_table3 <- as.data.frame(all_emmeans3$contrasts)
pairwise_table3 <- pairwise_table3 %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))) %>%
  select(Brain_Region, contrast, estimate, SE, df, z.ratio, p.value)

View(pairwise_table3)
write.csv(pairwise_table3, "emmeans_pairwise_table3.csv", row.names = FALSE) #save to a CSV file to add as table in manuscript
```

##Plotting LP and H Data
###LP
```{r}
LP_boxplot <- ggplot(LP_data, aes(x= Treatment, y = Obs_Avg, fill=Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + geom_point(aes(fill=as.factor(Treatment)),size=3.5, shape = 21, position=position_jitterdodge(1), alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=14), axis.title.y = element_text(size=14), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 0, color = "black"), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black")) +
  labs (x="Lateral pallium", y="# of pS6-stained cells") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  scale_x_discrete(limits=c("Baseline", "Sham", "MF")) + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0),limits = c(0,32)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#1B9E77","#D95F02", "#7570B3")) +
   geom_segment(aes(x="Baseline",xend="MF",y=30,yend=30)) + 
        annotate("text", x = c(2),y = c(30.5),label = c("***"), size=8) +
  geom_segment(aes(x="Sham",xend="MF",y=28,yend=28)) + 
        annotate("text",x = c(2.5),y = c(28.5),label = c("**"), size=8)

LP_boxplot
```

###H
```{r}
H_boxplot <- ggplot(H_data, aes(x= Treatment, y = Obs_Avg, fill=Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + geom_point(aes(fill=as.factor(Treatment)),size=3.5, shape = 21, position=position_jitterdodge(1), alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=14), axis.title.y = element_text(size=14), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 0, color = "black"), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs (x="Habenula", y="") + 
  scale_x_discrete(limits=c("Baseline", "Sham", "MF")) + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0),limits = c(0,32)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#1B9E77", "#7570B3", "#D95F02"), breaks = c("Baseline", "Sham", "MF")) +
   geom_segment(aes(x="Baseline",xend="MF",y=30,yend=30)) + 
        annotate("text", x = c(2),y = c(30.5),label = c("**"), size=8) +
  geom_segment(aes(x="Sham",xend="MF",y=28,yend=28)) + 
        annotate("text",x = c(2.5),y = c(28.5),label = c("***"), size=8)

H_boxplot
```

###Combining LP and H Plots
```{r}
ggarrange(LP_boxplot, H_boxplot,
                    labels = c("B", "C"),
                    ncol = 2, nrow = 1,
                    widths = c(1,1.4))

ggsave("Fig2.pdf", width=9, height=6, dpi=300)
```
